shots.alt: The minifigure builder: the figure's slots down the left, the heads that fit the chosen slot in the middle with colours under them, and the figure turning on the right with Keep and Place in model.
shots.caption: Make › Minifigure builder… (M): a figure from real parts, slot by slot.

shots.alt: The print designer on a white 2 x 2 tile, started from a control panel: the drawing tools down the left, the canvas in the middle, the tile with the print on it at the top right with Start from, Add a picture… and Layers under it, and the colours along the foot.
shots.caption: Print… in the parts bin draws on the part in hand.

shots.alt: Printed versions of a red 2 x 2 tile: a grid of the 433 printed and stickered tiles the LEGO Group made, each with its number and name, to swap the selected tile for.
shots.caption: Make › Printed versions… swaps a part for a print the LEGO Group made.

shots.alt: The Make a part dialog with Wedge chosen among its ten families: a red wedge plate in the preview, its width and length, which side is straight, and the words under them saying what it is, its far corner cut flat.
shots.caption: Make a part…: a 2 x 4 wedge plate with its far corner cut flat.
